summary: First-person arms to restyle: the engine's procedural arms (sleeves, bare forearms, hands curled for a grip) as a model document and an arms prefab for Viewmodel.arms; the hands reach any item's grip_r / grip_l by IK.
setup: A Viewmodel without `arms` already draws these arms; copy this piece only to change them: set "arms": "fp_arms" on the Viewmodel (under the first-person camera) and Game(plugins=[...]) needs viewmodel().

Restyle in assets/models/fp_arms.model.json: the "skin" and "sleeve" materials (or Model.colors on the prefab), the meshes, or the skeleton (keep the bone names LeftArm / LeftForeArm / LeftHand and RightArm / RightForeArm / RightHand: the Animator's left_hand / right_hand limbs bend them).
